operations.name: read_device_features
operations.desc: Read the device features register to determine supported RNG capabilities
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 0
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read the device status register to check current device state
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 6
in al, dx
movzx eax, al
ret

operations.name: read_interrupt_status
operations.desc: Read the interrupt status register to check for pending device events
operations.returns: 8-bit interrupt status (bit 0=used buffer notification, bit 1=configuration change)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 4
in al, dx
movzx eax, al
ret

operations.name: read_queue_size
operations.desc: Read the queue size register for the RNG request queue
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 12
in ax, dx
movzx eax, ax
ret

operations.name: read_device_id
operations.desc: Verify device identity by reading magic value and device ID
operations.returns: Device ID value (should be 0x1005 for VirtIO RNG)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 8
in ax, dx
movzx eax, ax
ret

operations.name: check_device_ready
operations.desc: Poll device ready state to ensure RNG is initialized and operational
operations.returns: Non-zero if device is ready and features negotiated, zero otherwise
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0xc040
add dx, 6
in al, dx
and al, 0x7
cmp al, 0x7
jne .not_ready
mov eax, 1
ret
.not_ready:
xor eax, eax
ret
